comment: Example Kibana / Elasticsearch rule definitions for Honeyshop. These are templates — create equivalent rules via the Kibana UI (Stack Management → Rules) or convert for Elastic Security Detection Engine.

rules.name: Honeyshop - High Volume Source IP
rules.description: Alert when a single source IP generates >= 20 interactions in 5 minutes

rules.name: Honeyshop - Login Attempts
rules.description: Alert on login_attempt events or concentrated SSH activity

rules.name: Honeyshop - Suspicious Payload
rules.description: Detect common exploit / malware payload patterns in captured data
rules.query: honeypot.payload: (*wget* or *curl* or *"/bin/bash"* or *"/bin/sh"* or *"nc -e"* or *"python -c"* or *base64* or *"chmod +x"* or *Mirai* or *BusyBox*)

rules.name: Honeyshop - Service Spike
rules.description: Alert when any single honeypot service receives >= 50 hits in 5 minutes
